title: Echo Agent
description: Use this when you need a reference agent to verify tool-calling wiring or test an orchestrator's delegation path — echoes text verbatim via echo_text or round-trips a JSON payload via echo_json.
author: sox-ecosystem

invocation.description: Exposes an array of Tool objects (echo_text, echo_json) consumed by the host orchestrator via the tool-calling protocol.

config_schema.description: Echo agent accepts no configuration — it is a zero-config reference extension.
